# ⚗️ SpleefLabs
We are a Minecraft server featuring a **full** Spleef competitive experience - No mods required.

## 🪏 Gamemodes
- Classic Spleef
- Splegg *(Coming Soon)*
- Bow Spleef *(Coming Soon)*
- Super Spleef *(Coming Soon)*

## 🗺️ Maps
Each map is carefully crafted to ensure a proper competitive experience.

![Spleef Arena](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8daac27299fc50c59c6ee9c07cdca84e19e24a12_0.webp)
